sn24.12:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave, sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati
sn24.12:1.4: bhagavammūlakā no bhante, dhammā …pe… rūpe kho bhikkhave, sati …pe… vedanāya sati …pe… saññāya sati …pe… saṅkhāresu sati …pe… viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati : “anantavā loko”ti. taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti? aniccaṃ bhante, …pe…. dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya “anantavā loko”ti? no hetaṃ bhante. vedanā …pe… saññā …pe… saṅkhārā …pe… viññāṇaṃ …pe… yampidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti ? …pe… dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya : “anantavā loko”ti? no hetaṃ bhante. yato kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa …pe…
